@graph.rdfs:comment:
This profile describes a material entity that is representative of a whole.

Comments: Typically samples are intended to be representative of the whole or aspects thereof. Examples of samples include biomedical samples (blood, urine) and commercial samples (carpet, metal).
@graph.rdfs:label: Sample

additionalProperty.description: A property-value pair representing an additional characteristic of the entity, that is not representable by an existing property.

alternateIdentifier.description: An additional identifier for the same instance of the resource.

citation.description: List publications where the sample is mentioned or described.

collectionMethod.description: Provide information about the conditions and methods of acquisition of samples.

collector.description: The Person or Organization who collected the Sample.

conditionsOfAccess.description: Sample access statement outlining conditions/requirements need to be fulfilled before access to the sample is granted.

conformsTo.description: Used to state the Bioschemas profile that the markup relates to. The versioned URL of the profile must be used. Note that we use a CURIE in the table here but the full URL for Dublin Core terms must be used in the markup (http://purl.org/dc/terms/conformsTo), see example.

contactPoint.description: A person or organization that can be contacted for more information or support.

contributor.description: A person or organization that contributes to the work.

dateCollected.description: The date on which the sample was collected.

dateCreated.description: The date the sample was created or added to a DataFeed.

dateModified.description: The date the sample record was last updated.

dateProcessed.description: The date the sample was processed or used in a method.

datePublished.description: The date when the record of the sample will be made publicly available.

environmentalSystem.description: A category or description of the habitat that describes elements of an ecosystem where the sample was collected. Where possible use controlled vocabulary such as ENVO.

ethics.description: Indicate which ethics policies and/or social considerations are associated with the sample.

experimentalPurpose.description: Describe the planned or executed experimental procedures involving the samples.

hasPart.description: Describe related items including other resources related to the samples. For example a subsample of this sample.

instrument.description: Provide description of instruments and devices used in collecting, processing and analysis of samples.

isControl.description: Indicates whether the sample is being used as a normal control, may be in combination with another sample.

isPartOf.description: Describe related items including other resources related to the samples. For example a supersample of this sample.

isRelatedTo.description: Describe related items including other resources related to the samples.

keywords.description: Terms that capture the main topics e.g. cancer, plant biology.

locationCreated.description: The place where a sample underwent processing or creation, distinct from its original location.

locationOfOrigin.description: The location from which the sample was originally collected.

maintainer.description: The Person or Organization who is responsible for the Sample.

sampleAvailability.description: Indicate whether this resource is available for reuse.

sampleProcess.description: The processing technique that was applied to the sample, methods used to prepare the samples, including SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures).

sampleQuantity.description: A numeric value for a measurement of the size  of a sample.

sampleState.description: Specify the composition and state of the sample. This can be used to indicate its physical state (gas, liquid, solid), degradation status (deteriorated, partially degraded) or passage number.

sampleStorageTemperature.description: The temperature at which the sample is stored.

sampleType.description: Indicate the type of sample. Note that this is intentionally broad to allow different types of specimens, i.e. cells, rock, sand.

studyTitle.description: Title of the study to which the samples belong

submitter.description: The person or organization that registers the sample.

identifier.description: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.

sameAs.description: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity. E.g. the URL of the item's Wikipedia page, Wikidata entry, or official website.
